intent.raw: Invoke a self-contained package for handing off the completed Categorical Learning System and Dynamic Neural Graph semantic-hierarchy research.
intent.objective: Create a private, portable, obligation-linked research-direction handoff that preserves the two source towers, evidence boundaries, corrected experiment path, residue, and next research-evidence-harness route without authorizing implementation or promotion.
intent.operator_sentence: Invoke hands the completed private research package to a researcher who will author the missing evidence harness.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The source research dispatch is already closed and this is one bounded local authoring route.
subagent_strategy.explanation: No subagent delegation is needed; Inventory lookup, Context Builder selection, Invoke handoff authoring, and validation are deterministic or parent-owned.

steps.name: Resolve the accepted result and local handoff template
stop_conditions: concrete_path_evidence must identify the accepted strategy-result entry
owner_boundary_check must preserve Inventory as a non-authority discovery surface

steps.name: Build strict obligation-linked researcher context
stop_conditions: sequence requires the Inventory selection before Context Builder synthesis
handle_handoff must map every selected source to an obligation
residue_ledger must preserve all six empirical or semantic gaps
protected_context_flag must keep the package inside private cyberAlchemy-v2
state_namespace_boundary must leave original sources unchanged and label the package as a derived handoff

steps.name: Author the portable researcher session handoff
stop_conditions: handle_handoff must preserve the copy-ready next-session prompt and selected context
owner_boundary_check must route evidence authoring to research-evidence-harness without claiming downstream lifecycle completion
artifact_contract_bridge requires link, JSON, hash, and obligation validation
observability_grouping records one Invoke handoff run and its artifact paths

gates.condition: All seven obligations are covered and every selected source maps to at least one obligation; residue_ledger entries remain explicit.
protected_context_flag and state_namespace_boundary keep the package private, preserve original sources, and prevent Inventory, the handoff, or paper terminology from becoming authority.
owner_boundary_check limits Invoke to handoff authoring and reserves fixtures, adapters, labels, policies, execution, semantic admission, and promotion for their named downstream owners.
artifact_contract_bridge and concrete_path_evidence pass Dispatch Spec, JSON parsing, Markdown-link, source-hash, manifest, and diff-hygiene checks.

observability.signal_grouping: observability_grouping: invoke handoff artifacts share dispatch_id invoke-handoff-20260723-ponder-ontology-evaluator-evidence-harness

boundaries.contract: state_namespace_boundary permits byte-identical source copies and new handoff metadata only; original research artifacts remain unchanged.
protected_context_flag marks this package private and local; transfer outside the authorized research relationship requires separate review.
handle_handoff transfers selected evidence and residue only; the downstream owner must separately establish its write scope, validators, fixtures, and receipts.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke owns only this handoff; research-evidence-harness owns the next evidence-package lifecycle.
authority.execution: No empirical execution is authorized by this dispatch.
authority.validation: Dispatch Spec and local package checks validate this handoff only.
authority.evidence: Preserved PDFs, source records, tower artifacts, accepted findings, and source-run receipt.
authority.memory: Inventory is a non-authority discovery view and receives no promotion from this handoff.
authority.promotion: CyberAlchemy-v2, Ponder data, ontology policy, and relevant lifecycle owners retain promotion authority.

state_namespaces.write_policy: original artifacts immutable for this handoff

promotion_guardrails: No paper claim, proposed threshold, fixture design, Inventory entry, or handoff statement becomes ontology or definition authority.
No implementation, training run, semantic admission, public publication, or production use is authorized.
The public Arcanum submodule receives no private CyberAlchemy-v2 content.
